state.assumptions: Each source-head certificate guarantees the exact current resource position and effective conditional append on that resource. A witness fence can be committed only after the exact edition abort has committed. A label release for the current held generation can be committed only after an exact edition terminal change. Edition abort, terminal label change and publication compete on the same edition resource with exact-position CAS. These storage and release guarantees are not yet qualified.
state.unknown: A publish append times out and no new publication fact is observed.

pending.instructions: Does the publisher return pending when any required source-head provider is absent before it has observed a prior publication?

cut.instructions: Does the publisher require a committed edition publication fact after appending before it returns success for a new publication?

unknown.instructions: Does the timeout in state.unknown prove the publication append failed?

pin_race.instructions: Under state.assumptions, can a witness fence for this attempt commit after the witness head read while a concurrent edition publication also commits at the same expected edition position?

label_race.instructions: Under state.assumptions, can release of the currently held label generation be authorized by an edition terminal decision that races and commits at the same edition position as publication?

qualified.instructions: Do state.assumptions say the production storage and release guarantees have been established?
